policy.source_snapshot: Every engine source must be vendored into third_party/engines/<id>/source at an immutable commit.
policy.git_mirror: A full Git mirror is retained in third_party/engines/<id>/git-mirror.git so tags, branches and commit objects remain available.
policy.build_evidence: Each benchmark run records source commit, dirty patch hash, submodule state, binary hash, build command, compiler/toolchain, effective arguments and environment (secrets redacted).
policy.license: Preserve LICENSE, COPYING, NOTICE, PATENTS, TRADEMARKS and attribution files verbatim. Never remove upstream license notices.
policy.artifacts: Each engine has a separate artifact format/model mapping; model and tokenizer hashes are recorded. No conversion is implicit.

engines.notes: Vendored by scripts/vendor_engines.py; retain Apache-2.0 and upstream notices.
Use the exact validated TensorFold commit/build and local model artifact; record CUDA reserve/device settings.
If Tandem.cpp is a local fork/patchset, configure repository URL and commit to that fork instead of upstream llama.cpp; do not substitute upstream silently.
No authoritative GitHub repository URL identified. Add the exact repository URL/ref before vendoring; do not guess.
